```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  sf,

)
```


```{r}
huc_level <- "huc08"
huc_col <- str_replace(huc_level, "huc0", "huc")

min_reaches <- 10
coherence_r2 <- 0.8
min_valid_months <- 6

dir_qc <- "../data/qc"
dir_qc_figs <- "../figures/qc"

dir.create(dir_qc, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dir_qc_figs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

path_flowlines <- "../data/processed/riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS.shp"
path_metabolism <- "../data/processed/05b_centroid_mismatch/05b_maavara_monthly_metabolism_centroid_filtered.rds"
path_removed_comids <- "../data/processed/05b_centroid_mismatch/05b_removed_comids.rds"
path_upstream_lookup <- "../data/processed/04_upstream_lookup.rds"
path_comid_characteristics <- "../data/dryad_data/scaling_dataset_Qmonth_06082024.csv"
path_existing_metrics <- "../data/processed/06_huc08_allometry_metrics.csv"
```


```{r}
flowlines_sf <- read_sf(path_flowlines) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    nxt_dw = as.character(nxt_dw)
  )

removed_comids <- readRDS(path_removed_comids) |>
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) |>
  distinct(comid)

metabolism <- readRDS(path_metabolism) |>
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

comid_characteristics <- read_csv(path_comid_characteristics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(comid, unitarea, lengthkm, merit_width, order, merit_qmean) |>
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    stream_area_m2 = lengthkm * 1000 * merit_width
  ) |>
  anti_join(removed_comids, by = "comid")

upstream_lookup <- readRDS(path_upstream_lookup) |>
  mutate(
    downstream_comid = as.character(downstream_comid),
    upstream_comid = as.character(upstream_comid)
  ) |>
  anti_join(removed_comids, by = c("downstream_comid" = "comid")) |>
  anti_join(removed_comids, by = c("upstream_comid" = "comid"))

existing_metrics <- read_csv(path_existing_metrics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    huc = as.character(huc),
    metabolism_var = recode(
      metabolism_var,
      c_gpp_flux_g_o2_d = "GPP",
      c_er_flux_g_o2_d = "ER",
      c_gpp_flux_go2_d = "GPP",
      c_er_flux_go2_d = "ER",
      c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = "GPP",
      c_er_flux_gO2_d = "ER",
      .default = metabolism_var
    )
  )
```


```{r}
huc_boundaries <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
  AOI = st_as_sfc(st_bbox(flowlines_sf)),
  type = huc_level,
  t_srs = st_crs(flowlines_sf)
) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(all_of(huc_col))

flowline_hucs <- flowlines_sf |>
  anti_join(removed_comids, by = "comid") |>
  st_point_on_surface() |>
  st_join(huc_boundaries, join = st_within) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) |>
  select(comid, huc = all_of(huc_col), uparea)

huc_comid_lookup <- flowline_hucs |>
  filter(!is.na(huc)) |>
  transmute(comid, huc)

flowline_hucs |>
  summarise(
    n_flowlines = n(),
    n_assigned_huc = sum(!is.na(huc)),
    n_missing_huc = sum(is.na(huc)),
    pct_missing_huc = n_missing_huc / n_flowlines * 100
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```


```{r}
upstream_lookup_huc <- upstream_lookup |>
  inner_join(
    huc_comid_lookup,
    by = c("downstream_comid" = "comid")
  ) |>
  rename(huc_downstream = huc) |>
  inner_join(
    huc_comid_lookup,
    by = c("upstream_comid" = "comid")
  ) |>
  rename(huc_upstream = huc) |>
  mutate(same_huc = huc_downstream == huc_upstream)

within_huc_lookup <- upstream_lookup_huc |>
  filter(same_huc) |>
  transmute(
    huc = huc_downstream,
    downstream_comid,
    upstream_comid
  )

upstream_lookup_huc |>
  summarise(
    n_pairs_with_assigned_hucs = n(),
    n_pairs_same_huc = sum(same_huc),
    n_pairs_cross_huc = sum(!same_huc),
    pct_pairs_cross_huc = n_pairs_cross_huc / n_pairs_with_assigned_hucs * 100
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```


```{r}
area_alignment_by_comid <- upstream_lookup |>
  group_by(downstream_comid) |>
  summarise(
    n_upstream_full_after_centroid_filter = n_distinct(upstream_comid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    within_huc_lookup |>
      group_by(huc, downstream_comid) |>
      summarise(
        n_upstream_within_huc = n_distinct(upstream_comid),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "downstream_comid"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    within_huc_lookup |>
      left_join(
        comid_characteristics |> select(upstream_comid = comid, unitarea),
        by = "upstream_comid"
      ) |>
      group_by(huc, downstream_comid) |>
      summarise(
        unitarea_sum_within_huc = sum(unitarea, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("huc", "downstream_comid")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    flowline_hucs |> select(downstream_comid = comid, uparea),
    by = "downstream_comid"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_upstream_within_huc = replace_na(n_upstream_within_huc, 0L),
    unitarea_sum_within_huc = replace_na(unitarea_sum_within_huc, 0),
    area_alignment_ratio = unitarea_sum_within_huc / uparea,
    upstream_count_alignment_ratio = n_upstream_within_huc / n_upstream_full_after_centroid_filter
  )

write_csv(
  area_alignment_by_comid,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_area_metabolism_alignment_by_comid.csv")
)

area_alignment_by_comid |>
  summarise(
    n_downstream_comids = n(),
    median_area_alignment_ratio = median(area_alignment_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    p10_area_alignment_ratio = quantile(area_alignment_ratio, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_area_alignment_ratio = quantile(area_alignment_ratio, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_ratio_lt_0_5 = mean(area_alignment_ratio < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_ratio_lt_0_9 = mean(area_alignment_ratio < 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```


```{r}
area_alignment_by_huc <- area_alignment_by_comid |>
  filter(!is.na(huc)) |>
  group_by(huc) |>
  summarise(
    n_downstream_comids = n(),
    median_area_alignment_ratio = median(area_alignment_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_area_alignment_ratio = min(area_alignment_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    p10_area_alignment_ratio = quantile(area_alignment_ratio, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_reaches_ratio_lt_0_5 = mean(area_alignment_ratio < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_reaches_ratio_lt_0_9 = mean(area_alignment_ratio < 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    median_upstream_count_alignment_ratio = median(upstream_count_alignment_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_area_alignment_ratio)

write_csv(
  area_alignment_by_huc,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_area_metabolism_alignment_by_huc8.csv")
)

area_alignment_by_huc |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
metabolism_scaled <- metabolism |>
  left_join(comid_characteristics, by = "comid") |>
  transmute(
    comid,
    month,
    gpp_flux_gO2_d = gpp * stream_area_m2,
    er_flux_gO2_d = er * stream_area_m2
  )

cumulative_metabolism_audit <- within_huc_lookup |>
  left_join(
    metabolism_scaled |>
      select(upstream_comid = comid, month, gpp_flux_gO2_d, er_flux_gO2_d),
    by = "upstream_comid",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  group_by(huc, downstream_comid, month) |>
  summarise(
    c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = sum(gpp_flux_gO2_d, na.rm = TRUE),
    c_er_flux_gO2_d = sum(er_flux_gO2_d, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    flowline_hucs |> select(downstream_comid = comid, uparea_full_merit = uparea),
    by = "downstream_comid"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    area_alignment_by_comid |>
      select(
        huc,
        downstream_comid,
        unitarea_sum_within_huc,
        area_alignment_ratio,
        upstream_count_alignment_ratio
      ),
    by = c("huc", "downstream_comid")
  )

cumulative_metabolism_audit |>
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_hucs = n_distinct(huc),
    n_downstream_comids = n_distinct(downstream_comid),
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    pct_missing_full_uparea = mean(is.na(uparea_full_merit)) * 100,
    pct_missing_within_area = mean(is.na(unitarea_sum_within_huc)) * 100
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```


```{r}
fit_allometry <- function(data, area_col, fit_label) {
  
  data |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(c_gpp_flux_gO2_d, c_er_flux_gO2_d),
      names_to = "metabolism_var",
      values_to = "cumulative_metabolism"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      area = .data[[area_col]],
      metabolism_var = recode(
        metabolism_var,
        c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = "GPP",
        c_er_flux_gO2_d = "ER"
      )
    ) |>
    filter(
      area > 0,
      cumulative_metabolism > 0,
      !is.na(area),
      !is.na(cumulative_metabolism)
    ) |>
    group_by(huc, month, metabolism_var) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      fit = list(if (n() >= 3) lm(log10(cumulative_metabolism) ~ log10(area)) else NULL),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      intercept = map_dbl(fit, \(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else coef(x)[1]),
      slope = map_dbl(fit, \(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else coef(x)[2]),
      r2 = map_dbl(fit, \(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else summary(x)$r.squared),
      fit_label = fit_label
    ) |>
    select(-fit)
}

allometry_existing_area <- fit_allometry(
  cumulative_metabolism_audit,
  area_col = "uparea_full_merit",
  fit_label = "existing_full_uparea"
)

allometry_aligned_area <- fit_allometry(
  cumulative_metabolism_audit,
  area_col = "unitarea_sum_within_huc",
  fit_label = "aligned_within_huc_area"
)

allometry_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  allometry_existing_area,
  allometry_aligned_area
) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = fit_label,
    values_from = c(n, intercept, slope, r2)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    slope_delta = slope_aligned_within_huc_area - slope_existing_full_uparea,
    r2_delta = r2_aligned_within_huc_area - r2_existing_full_uparea,
    existing_pass_month = n_existing_full_uparea >= min_reaches & r2_existing_full_uparea >= coherence_r2,
    aligned_pass_month = n_aligned_within_huc_area >= min_reaches & r2_aligned_within_huc_area >= coherence_r2,
    month_pass_changed = existing_pass_month != aligned_pass_month
  )

write_csv(
  allometry_sensitivity,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_existing_vs_aligned_allometry_sensitivity.csv")
)

allometry_sensitivity |>
  summarise(
    n_huc_month_var = n(),
    median_slope_delta = median(slope_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2_delta = median(r2_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_month_pass_changed = mean(month_pass_changed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```


```{r}
existing_fit_check <- allometry_existing_area |>
  select(huc, month, metabolism_var, n_rebuilt = n, slope_rebuilt = slope, r2_rebuilt = r2) |>
  left_join(
    existing_metrics |>
      select(huc, month, metabolism_var, n_existing = n, slope_existing = slope, r2_existing = r2),
    by = c("huc", "month", "metabolism_var")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_diff = n_rebuilt - n_existing,
    slope_diff = slope_rebuilt - slope_existing,
    r2_diff = r2_rebuilt - r2_existing
  )

write_csv(
  existing_fit_check,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_rebuilt_existing_fit_check.csv")
)

existing_fit_check |>
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    pct_missing_saved_metric = mean(is.na(slope_existing)) * 100,
    max_abs_n_diff = max(abs(n_diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_slope_diff = max(abs(slope_diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_r2_diff = max(abs(r2_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 6)
```


```{r}
huc_sensitivity <- allometry_sensitivity |>
  group_by(huc, metabolism_var) |>
  summarise(
    n_months_existing_valid = sum(existing_pass_month, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_months_aligned_valid = sum(aligned_pass_month, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_slope_existing = median(slope_existing_full_uparea, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_slope_aligned = median(slope_aligned_within_huc_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_slope_delta = median(slope_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2_existing = median(r2_existing_full_uparea, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2_aligned = median(r2_aligned_within_huc_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2_delta = median(r2_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_month_pass_changed = any(month_pass_changed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    existing_coherent = n_months_existing_valid >= min_valid_months,
    aligned_coherent = n_months_aligned_valid >= min_valid_months,
    coherence_changed = existing_coherent != aligned_coherent
  ) |>
  left_join(
    area_alignment_by_huc,
    by = "huc"
  ) |>
  arrange(coherence_changed, median_area_alignment_ratio)

write_csv(
  huc_sensitivity,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_huc8_area_alignment_sensitivity_summary.csv")
)

huc_sensitivity |>
  count(metabolism_var, existing_coherent, aligned_coherent, coherence_changed) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
decision_summary <- huc_sensitivity |>
  mutate(
    audit_flag = case_when(
      median_area_alignment_ratio < 0.5 & coherence_changed ~ "major_alignment_and_classification_change",
      median_area_alignment_ratio < 0.5 ~ "major_area_alignment_mismatch",
      coherence_changed ~ "classification_changes_after_area_alignment",
      median_area_alignment_ratio < 0.9 ~ "moderate_area_alignment_mismatch",
      TRUE ~ "little_evidence_of_area_alignment_problem"
    )
  )

write_csv(
  decision_summary,
  file.path(dir_qc, "10_area_alignment_decision_summary.csv")
)

decision_summary |>
  count(metabolism_var, audit_flag) |>
  arrange(metabolism_var, desc(n)) |>
  kable()

decision_summary |>
  arrange(median_area_alignment_ratio) |>
  select(
    huc,
    metabolism_var,
    audit_flag,
    median_area_alignment_ratio,
    n_months_existing_valid,
    n_months_aligned_valid,
    existing_coherent,
    aligned_coherent,
    median_slope_delta,
    median_r2_delta
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 30) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

```
